```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)

```

```{r}
dt <- read_csv("mort_data.csv")
head(dt)
```
```{r}
# Assuming 'df' is your dataframe
dt <- dt %>%
  mutate(
    fhb = factor(fhb),
    loan_St = factor(loan_St),
    purpose = factor(purpose)
  )

# Optionally, check the structure to confirm changes
str(dt)
```
```{r}
summary(dt)
```

```{r}
levels(dt$loan_St)
```


```{r}
# Histograms for numeric variables like DTI and CreditScore
ggplot(dt, aes(x = dti)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "tomato4") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Debt to Income Ratio", x = "DTI", y = "Frequency")

ggplot(dt, aes(x = creditScore)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "skyblue") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Credit Score", x = "Credit Score", y = "Frequency")

ggplot(dt, aes(x = or_amt)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "orchid4") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of loan amount", x = "loan amount", y = "Frequency")

ggplot(dt, aes(x = or_rt)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "seagreen3") +
  labs(title = "Distribution", x = "Original rate", y = "Frequency")

ggplot(dt, aes(x = ltv)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "royalblue") +
  labs(title = "Distribution", x = "loan-value", y = "Frequency")

ggplot(dt, aes(x = in_rt)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "salmon") +
  labs(title = "Distribution", x = "interest rate", y = "Frequency")
```

```{r}
# Scatter plot between DTI and CreditScore
ggplot(dt, aes(x = ltv, y = creditScore)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Scatter Plot: DTI vs. Credit Score", x = "loan-value", y = "Credit Score")
```

```{r}
dt <- dt %>%
  mutate(
    Default_Status = case_when(
      loan_St %in% c("Current", "Paid Off") ~ 0,  # No default
      loan_St %in% c("Delinquent", "Foreclosure", "Modified or Sold") ~ 1,  # Default
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_  # Handling 'Other' or undefined statuses as NA for now
    )
  )

dt <- dt %>%
  filter(!is.na(Default_Status))

# Assuming 'df' is your dataframe
dt <- dt %>%
  mutate(
    loan_stat = factor(Default_Status),
  )

dt <- dt %>%
  select(-loan_St, -Default_Status)

# Optionally, check the structure to confirm changes
str(dt)
```

```{r}
# Faceted scatter plot by Purpose
ggplot(data = dt, aes(x = dti, y = creditScore)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = loan_stat), alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~purpose, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "royalblue4", "1" = "orangered")) +
  labs(title = "DTI vs. Credit Score by Purpose",
       x = "Debt to Income Ratio",
       y = "Credit Score",
       color = "Loan Status") +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}
# Calculate correlations
library(corrplot)

cor_data <- dt %>%
  select(dti, creditScore, or_amt, ltv, dti, or_rt, in_rt) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs")

# Plot correlation heatmap
corrplot(cor_data, method = "color")

```
```{r}

       x = "First-Time Home Buyer",
       y = "Original Loan Amount",
       fill = "Loan Status") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
g <- ggplot(data = dt, aes(y = ltv, x = dti))
g + geom_point(size = 3)
g + geom_point(aes(color = purpose), size = 3)
```


```{r}
# Boxplot of Original Amount by Loan Status and First Home Buyer status
ggplot(data = dt, aes(x = purpose, y = ltv, fill = loan_stat)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "tan4", "1" = "plum2")) +
  labs(title = "Loan to value by Loan Status and purpose",

```
```{r}
# 2. Box Plot of Loan-to-Value (LTV) Ratio by Loan Status
ggplot(dt, aes(x = loan_stat, y = creditScore, fill = loan_stat)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Credit score by Loan Status", x = "Loan Status", y = "credit score") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("lightgreen", "tomato3")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Scatter plot comparing Current Interest Rate to Original Interest Rate
ggplot(data = dt, aes(x = or_rt, y = in_rt)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = loan_stat), alpha = 0.5) +  # Color code by loan status
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "slateblue", "1" = "tomato")) +  # No default vs. Default
  labs(title = "Comparison of Original Interest Rate vs. Current Interest Rate",
       x = "Original Interest Rate (%)",
       y = "Current Interest Rate (%)",
       color = "Loan Status") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray")  # Add y=x line

```

```{r}
# Fit Logistic Regression Model
logistic_model <- glm(loan_stat ~ creditScore + ltv + dti + in_rt, 
                      data = dt, 
                      family = binomial)

# Summary of the Regression Model
summary(logistic_model)
```

```{r}
# Interpreting Coefficients
# Odds Ratios for Each Variable
exp(coef(logistic_model))
```

```{r}
# Predicting and ROC Curve Analysis
# Predicting Probability of Default
dt$predicted_prob <- predict(logistic_model, type = "response")

# Generate ROC Curve
roc_obj <- roc(dt$loan_stat, dt$predicted_prob)
plot(roc_obj, main = "ROC Curve for Logistic Regression Model", col = "slateblue4")
auc(roc_obj)

# Visualizations for Regression Analysis
# Visualize Predicted Probabilities vs. Observed Outcomes
ggplot(dt, aes(x = predicted_prob, fill = loan_stat)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Predicted Probability vs. Observed Loan Status", x = "Predicted Probability of Default", y = "Count")
```
